rule_or_requirement: User requests visible-map acceleration, short anticipatory braking and faster complete laps.
observable_information: Rendered road corridor and obstacle, current HUD, own prior pedals.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Four pedal mechanisms: distance reachability, arrival-time budget, lateral steering reservation, adaptive acceleration response. Stable steering algorithm retained.
expected_success_endpoint: 6/6 control finishes preserved with lower finished median; target half time remains distinct.
falsifier: No pedal activation, lost completion, no time improvement, invalid action or state leakage.
resource_and_risk_gate: 2CPU2GiB1200s run budget;1200decision episodes; profile outer1800s; local only.
